invariants.rationale: The method requires a StorageConfiguration instance; passing null would likely break downstream logic.
writeConfig is passed to the constructor and likely required to configure the metadata writer.
The cleaning policy is necessary to maintain invariants about handling failed writes; null would not make sense.
The HoodieEngineContext is required to execute actions in the writer and cannot be null.
Option objects representing instant timestamps should not be null; the Option can represent an empty value, but not be null itself.
